name: Hourglass of the Lost
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {W}. Put a time counter on this artifact.
{T}, Remove X time counters from this artifact and exile it: Return each nonland permanent card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.
blocked_sentences: {T}, Remove X time counters from this artifact and exile it: Return each nonland permanent card with mana value X from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that removes an announced number X of a named counter kind (here time counters) from the source itself, X chosen by the controller on activation (0 up to the counters on the source) and bound so the effects can read it with {"x": true}, so the resolution can return each nonland permanent card with mana value exactly X
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost.remove_counters takes only a fixed integer amount (Cost reads int(amount)); loyalty_x is the variable form but only for loyalty counters and drags in planeswalker-ability rules (606.3 once per turn); x_value defines the X of an {X} in the mana cost from a value expression, and this cost has no {X} for the player to announce; remove_counters_from_among also takes a fixed count
